overview: This House resolution assigns a member of the House, Representative Gallagher, to three standing committees: Foreign Affairs; Science, Space, and Technology; and Transportation and Infrastructure. Standing committees are the permanent panels that review bills and oversee federal agencies in their subject areas. Resolutions like this are the routine way the House fills committee seats. It does not change any law. The House adopted it on June 24, 2026.
for: Supporters say it is a routine step that lets a member take part in committee work and keeps the committees fully staffed.
against: Critics say it is an internal housekeeping measure that does not change any law or policy; committee assignments are rarely controversial.
